title: Pickle and Caper Tartar Sauce
summary: Mayonnaise loaded with chopped dill pickles, shallot, capers, parsley and dill, lifted with lemon and a touch of mild mustard.

steps.title: Chop finely
steps.text: Finely chop the pickles, shallot, capers, parsley and dill. Small, even pieces spread through the sauce so no single bite is too sharp.

steps.title: Stir together
steps.text: Put the mayonnaise in the bowl and stir in the chopped ingredients, lemon juice, yellow mustard and pepper until evenly mixed.

steps.title: Let it rest
steps.text: Cover and chill for 20 min. The shallot loses its raw bite and the pickle tang spreads through the mayonnaise.

steps.title: Taste and serve
steps.text: Taste and add a few more drops of lemon if you want it sharper. Serve alongside fried or grilled fish with lemon wedges.

tips: Pat the chopped pickles dry on kitchen paper so the sauce does not turn watery.
Rinse the capers if they are packed in salt.
Try it with chips, fishcakes or in a fish sandwich.
Taste before adding any salt; the pickles and capers are already salty.
storage: Keep in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
